name: gizza-ai/parse-http-message
summary: Parse a raw HTTP/1.x request or response into structured fields

tool.description: Parse a raw HTTP/1.x request or response message into structured JSON: the message kind, method/target/path/query (requests) or status code/reason/class (responses), HTTP version, all headers in order with duplicates preserved, Content-Type / Content-Length / chunked flags, and the body.

message.description: The raw HTTP/1.x request or response to parse, including the start line, headers, a blank line, and any body. Request and response messages are detected automatically. Bare-LF line endings are tolerated.
